titleZh: 酒店人手有限，采购、验收和付款怎样分工？
titleEn: Hotel Purchasing with Limited Staff: Who Should Buy, Receive and Pay?
summaryZh: 酒店人手有限时，如何安排采购、验收与付款职责，识别兼岗冲突，并让原始证据、账户权限和紧急采购复核真正落实。附职责权限矩阵和采购走查模板。
summaryEn: Separate purchasing, receiving and payment responsibilities when hotel staffing is limited. Check combined roles, original evidence, system access and urgent purchases, with responsibility and transaction review templates.
contentZh:
酒店人手有限，采购、验收和付款怎样分工？

酒店人手有限时，应先把购买决定、交付确认和付款控制分开，再为确实无法分开的兼岗安排独立复核；分工是否有效，要看谁掌握权限、谁提供证据，不能只数一张单据上有几个签名。

采购专员可以负责询价、联系送货和录入订单，但如果同一个人还能够独自确认到货、修改结算依据并完成付款，几道手续可能仍由一个人控制。相反，每次买一件常用配件都等待业主签字，也可能耽误维修，却没有增加对实物和价格的核实。

酒店采购分工要解决的，是在供应不断档的前提下，让关键判断有人负责，也有人能够核查。

先分清每个人究竟确认什么

采购中的签字至少涉及几种不同判断：业务上是否需要，购买条件是否获准，实物或服务是否按约交付，以及款项是否应当支付。确认预算允许，不代表已经收到合格货物；看到发票，也不能代替验收。

财政部《企业内部控制应用指引第7号——采购业务》将请购、审批、购买、验收和付款等环节的职责与权限分别列明。这为梳理流程提供了参考，但具体酒店仍须根据经营主体适用的制度、业务风险和授权要求确定安排，不能把同一张分工表套给所有酒店。

总经理可以先让相关人员回答几个朴素的问题：谁能说明为什么要买，谁有权决定向谁买、按什么条件买，谁能证明确实收到了约定的东西，谁检查付款依据，谁最终执行支付。只说“采购负责”“财务把关”，往往还不够具体。

采购、验收和付款的职责怎样落到人

下面是一种用于讨论的分工示例，不是统一岗位配置。酒店可以用现有人员承担相应职责，但应识别其中是否存在自己批准自己、自己证明自己或自己监督自己的情况。

请购由使用部门说明用途、规格、所需时间及数量依据。批准人判断必要性、预算和授权范围；不能让经办人仅凭自己填写的需求就取得购买权限。采购量本身是否合理，可以另行参考《酒店客用品库存积压，采购量该怎么调整？》，不必在分工制度里重做一套库存算法。

采购执行人按批准条件询价、下单并跟踪交付。遇到价格、规格或供应商变化，应把变化交给有权人员确认，不能为了让后续单据一致而直接修改原来的批准记录。

验收人确认实际交付的数量、规格和状态。使用部门负责判断物品是否适用；涉及设备或技术服务时，应由具备相应能力的人确认结果。货物送到前台，只能证明有人接收了包裹，不能自动证明其中设备合格或维修服务完成。

财务审核人依据合同、采购及验收记录核对结算条件，识别预付款、已付款、退货和扣款等调整，避免重复支付。付款批准人承担授权判断，支付经办人按批准结果办理。具体岗位、账户和支付工具的设置，还应满足酒店适用的资金管理要求。

这套安排的关键是证据能够相互核对。例如，验收记录应来自实际核验，付款审核应能直接看到原始记录；采购经办人口头转述“部门已经同意”，不能替代相应确认。

人员兼岗时，把缺口写出来

假设一家酒店没有专职仓管，采购专员既联系供应商，也录入到货信息。以下是方法示例，并非客户案例：酒店可以安排实际使用物品的部门核对交付，财务读取其确认记录，再审核结算；采购专员录单的便利保留下来，但不能同时成为唯一的交付证明人。

如果夜间确实无人能够独立核验，应写明这次缺少哪一项核查、由谁补做、何时完成、谁跟踪逾期。照片可以辅助记录数量和外观，却未必能证明设备性能、服务质量或食品状态，不能为了少安排一名核验人而高估照片的作用。

2017年《小企业内部控制规范（试行）》对资源有限、无法实现不相容岗位分离的情况，提出抽查交易文档、定期资产盘点等替代控制。符合其适用条件的酒店可以据此设计安排；替代控制须针对实际缺口，也不能用于绕开其他适用规定要求的职责分离。

例如，事后复核能帮助发现异常，却无法把一笔已经无法追回的付款变成低风险交易。金额重要、预付比例高、交付难以核实或涉及关联关系的采购，应提高事前核查程度，必要时由业主或相应授权机构决定是否增配人员、引入专业核验或改变交易条件。

小额常规采购则可以在授权范围内简化流转，同时保留抽查。频繁出现的“临时例外”也值得重新审视：它可能意味着常规流程不适用，也可能意味着有人持续绕过流程，需要分别查明。

纸面分工还要对应实际权限

一张表写着三个人负责，不等于系统里已经分权。若采购经办人使用共享账户，既能改供应商信息、改订单和验收结果，又能发起并放行付款，纸面分工就可能失效。

总经理应组织财务及负责系统权限的人员核对实际账户权限，按工作需要配置访问、修改和支付权限，并保留变更记录。有条件时，让关键修改触发独立复核。没有采购系统的酒店，也可以通过分别保管原始文件、保存修改版本和独立取得验收确认减少单人控制信息的机会。

业主本人也应在授权和留痕范围内办理采购。若业主临时指定购买，却要求财务事后补成“正常审批”，记录便不能准确解释决定如何作出。特别授权应说明理由、范围和责任，不能靠补签掩盖实际过程。

紧急采购要有一条能走通的路

以夜间设备故障、急需购买配件为假设情景，酒店可事先确定值班人员的采购权限、可联系的批准人及补充核验安排。具体金额和时限由酒店按风险确定，不宜照搬统一数字。

经办人在当时留下故障影响、必须立即购买的理由、供应商、价格依据和批准记录。配件到场后，由具备能力的人核实安装或使用结果；财务再按合同和支付安排核对款项。紧急预付款无法等待最终验收时，应另行明确预付依据、授权及后续追踪，不能把预付款伪装成已经完成验收的结算款。

发现差异时，应先查明是记录缺失、质量争议、重复结算还是其他异常，由有权人员决定处理。酒店应区分无争议的到期应付款与需要核实的争议部分，按合同及适用要求处理，不能把内部手续不全一概当作拖欠供应商的理由。

用一张职责表和一笔采购验证

经营会上可以使用一张采购职责与权限表。每个环节填明执行人、批准或复核人、所需原始证据、系统或支付权限、兼岗冲突、替代控制、完成时点及异常升级人。填名字之前，先写清这个环节要验证的事实，才能判断所安排的人是否有能力、有信息完成核查。

再选一笔真实采购，从需求提出一直追到付款：批准条件有无被改变，验收者是否实际核验，财务是否看到原始依据，账户权限是否允许经办人绕过复核。文件齐全只是起点，记录是否可信、差异能否解释，才决定这次检查有没有价值。

最低成本的做法，是由总经理授权、财务牵头，选一个采购品类，在一个实际结算周期内试行。业务部门提供交付记录，负责系统权限的人员提供权限清单，业主或获授权的监督人员复核重要异常；负责执行控制的人不能仅靠自查证明监督已经完成。

试行结束时，检查无法独立核实的交易是否减少、例外是否按期关闭、重复或差异付款是否得到处理，也要看正常采购有无新增不必要的延误。没有发现问题并不自动证明控制有效，还要确认抽查确实覆盖了关键权限和证据。

若出现无法解释的重要付款、原始记录被擅改或例外逾期未复核，应升级处理，必要时暂停对应的例外权限，补上核查后再决定恢复；不必因此让全店正常采购停摆。若流程只是增加等待，却没有获得新的核验信息，就应调整复核节点，而非继续加签。

食品、工程及其他专业采购仍须另行满足相应质量、安全和专业要求，这张表不能替代专业验收。对人员有限的酒店，迈创兄弟C&T（MarvelBros C&T）建议从一笔真实采购开始：把实际决定、证据和权限画清楚，再决定需要调整哪一个岗位或哪一项授权。
contentEn:
Hotel Purchasing with Limited Staff: Who Should Buy, Receive and Pay?

A hotel with limited staff should first separate purchasing decisions, confirmation of delivery and control of payments, then arrange independent review where duties genuinely cannot be separated. Effective hotel purchasing controls depend on who holds the authority and who supplies the evidence, rather than the number of signatures on a document.

A purchasing officer may obtain quotations, arrange deliveries and enter orders. But if that same person can independently confirm receipt, change settlement records and complete payment, several procedures may still be controlled by one individual. Conversely, requiring the owner to approve every routine spare part may delay repairs without adding any verification of the goods or price.

The purpose of dividing purchasing responsibilities is to keep supplies flowing while ensuring that someone is responsible for each critical judgment and that someone can check it.

Establish what each person is actually confirming

Signatures in a purchasing process can represent several different judgments: whether the business needs the purchase, whether the terms have been authorized, whether the goods or services have been delivered as agreed, and whether payment is due. Budget approval does not confirm receipt of acceptable goods, and an invoice cannot replace inspection and acceptance.

China's Ministry of Finance, in Application Guideline No. 7 for Enterprise Internal Control: Purchasing, separately identifies responsibilities and authority for requisitions, approval, purchasing, inspection and acceptance, and payment. This provides a reference for reviewing the process. Each hotel should still determine its arrangements according to the rules applicable to its operating entity, business risks and authorization requirements, rather than apply one responsibility chart to every property.

The general manager can begin by asking the people involved some straightforward questions: who can explain why the purchase is needed, who may decide the supplier and purchasing terms, who can demonstrate that the agreed goods or services were actually received, who checks the basis for payment, and who executes it? Saying that purchasing handles it and finance checks it is often insufficiently specific.

Assign purchasing, receiving and payment responsibilities

The following is an example for discussion, rather than a standard staffing structure. Existing employees can perform the relevant roles, but the hotel should identify situations in which people approve their own actions, provide the only evidence of their own work or supervise themselves.

The requesting department explains the purpose, specifications, required date and basis for the quantity. The approver assesses necessity, budget and authority. An employee should not obtain purchasing authority simply by submitting their own request. For a separate examination of whether the quantity is appropriate, refer to Hotel Guest Supply Overstock: How Should Purchasing Quantities Be Adjusted? There is no need to recreate an inventory calculation system inside the responsibility policy.

The purchaser obtains quotations, places the order and follows delivery under the approved terms. Changes to price, specifications or supplier should be referred to the person with the appropriate authority. The purchaser should not simply alter the original approval record to make subsequent documents agree.

The person responsible for inspection and acceptance confirms the quantity, specifications and condition of what was delivered. The user department determines whether the goods are suitable. Equipment or technical services require confirmation by someone with the relevant capability. Delivery to the front desk demonstrates only that someone received a package; it does not automatically establish that the equipment is acceptable or a repair service is complete.

The finance reviewer checks settlement terms against the contract, purchasing and acceptance records, accounting for adjustments such as advance payments, amounts already paid, returns and deductions to avoid duplicate payment. The payment approver makes the authorization decision, and the payment operator acts on that approval. Roles, accounts and payment tools must also meet the funds-management requirements applicable to the hotel.

The essential feature is that evidence can be cross-checked. Acceptance records should reflect actual verification, and the payment reviewer should have direct access to the original records. A purchaser's verbal assurance that a department has agreed cannot replace that department's confirmation.

Make gaps in combined roles explicit

Suppose a hotel has no dedicated storekeeper, so the purchaser both contacts suppliers and enters receipt information. This is an illustrative method, not a client case. The hotel can arrange for the department using the goods to verify delivery, with finance consulting that confirmation before reviewing settlement. The convenience of having the purchaser enter data is retained, but that person cannot also provide the only evidence of delivery.

If nobody is available for independent verification at night, specify which check is missing, who will complete it, by when, and who will follow up if it is late. Photographs can help record quantity and appearance, but may not establish equipment performance, service quality or the condition of food. Their usefulness should not be overstated to avoid assigning a verifier.

The Ministry of Finance's 2017 Internal Control Standards for Small Enterprises (Trial) addresses resource constraints that prevent the separation of incompatible duties, identifying alternative controls such as checking transaction documents and periodic asset counts. Hotels within its scope can use this as a basis for designing arrangements. Alternative controls must address the actual gap and cannot circumvent separation requirements under other applicable rules.

For example, a later review can help detect an irregularity, but cannot turn an irrecoverable payment into a low-risk transaction. A purchase involving a material amount, a high advance payment, delivery that is difficult to verify or a related-party relationship warrants stronger checks before commitment. Where necessary, the owner or appropriate authorized body should decide whether to add personnel, obtain specialist verification or change the transaction terms.

Small, routine purchases can follow simpler procedures within authorized limits, while remaining subject to spot checks. Repeated temporary exceptions also deserve examination. They may indicate that the standard process does not fit the business, or that someone is repeatedly bypassing it. Establish which explanation applies.

Match the responsibility chart to actual access rights

A chart naming three responsible people does not establish that system access has been separated. If a purchaser uses a shared account that can change supplier details, orders and acceptance results, as well as initiate and release payments, the documented division of duties may fail.

The general manager should have finance and the people responsible for system access review actual account permissions. Assign viewing, editing and payment rights according to work requirements and retain change records. Where feasible, make critical changes subject to independent review. A hotel without a purchasing system can still reduce one person's control over information by keeping original documents separately, retaining amendment histories and obtaining acceptance confirmation independently.

Owners should also act within the authorization and recordkeeping arrangements when making purchases. If an owner directs an exceptional purchase but asks finance to document it afterwards as a routine approval, the record will not accurately explain how the decision was made. Special authorization should identify its reason, scope and responsibility; retrospective signatures should not conceal what actually happened.

Provide a workable route for urgent purchases

Consider a hypothetical equipment failure at night that requires an urgent spare part. The hotel can define in advance the duty employee's purchasing authority, the approver who can be contacted and the arrangements for subsequent verification. Amount limits and deadlines should reflect the hotel's risks, rather than a universal figure.

At the time, the purchaser records the impact of the failure, why an immediate purchase is necessary, the supplier, the basis for the price and the approval. Once the part arrives, a suitably capable person verifies the installation or result, and finance checks payment against the contract and payment arrangements. If an urgent advance cannot wait for final acceptance, separately document its basis, authorization and subsequent tracking. Do not present an advance as settlement for a purchase that has already passed acceptance.

When a discrepancy arises, establish whether it concerns missing records, a quality dispute, duplicate settlement or another irregularity, and refer the response to an authorized person. Distinguish undisputed amounts due from disputed items requiring verification, and handle them under the contract and applicable requirements. Incomplete internal paperwork should not become a blanket reason to withhold payment from suppliers.

Test the arrangements with one responsibility chart and one purchase

An operating meeting can use a purchasing responsibility and authority chart. For each stage, record the person performing it, the approver or reviewer, the original evidence required, system or payment permissions, conflicting combined roles, alternative controls, deadlines and the escalation contact. Before assigning names, define the fact that each stage must verify. This makes it possible to assess whether the assigned person has the capability and information needed.

Then select one actual purchase and trace it from the request through to payment. Check whether approved terms changed, whether the acceptance reviewer actually verified delivery, whether finance saw the original evidence, and whether account permissions allow the purchaser to bypass review. Complete paperwork is only a starting point. The value of the check depends on whether the records are reliable and discrepancies can be explained.

A low-cost starting point is a trial covering one purchasing category over one actual settlement cycle, authorized by the general manager and led by finance. Operating departments supply delivery records; those responsible for system access supply permission lists; the owner or an authorized supervisor reviews significant exceptions. The person performing a control cannot demonstrate that supervision has occurred through self-checking alone.

At the end of the trial, examine whether fewer transactions lack independent verification, exceptions close on time, and duplicate or discrepant payments are addressed. Also check whether normal purchasing has suffered unnecessary additional delays. Finding no problems does not automatically establish that controls are effective: confirm that the checks covered critical permissions and evidence.

An unexplained material payment, unauthorized alteration of original records or an overdue exception review should be escalated. Where necessary, suspend the relevant exception authority, complete the missing checks and then decide whether to restore it. Normal purchasing across the hotel need not come to a halt. If the process merely increases waiting without obtaining additional verification, adjust the review point instead of adding more signatures.

Food, engineering and other specialist purchases must still meet their relevant quality, safety and professional requirements. This chart cannot replace specialist acceptance. For a hotel with limited staff, MarvelBros C&T recommends starting with one actual purchase: map the real decisions, evidence and permissions, then decide which role or authorization needs to change.
author: MarvelBros C&T
